name: pending
description: v4 C5 (explore drafts a-quiet-line): one line of the system's quiet print for something not done yet, where it is; nothing around it changes shape. Status form: under an unsent entry or voice memo's words and tools (a row's span place), a 14px upload arrow, the words and Try again (the quiet button) at its end, role status. Draft form: under the composer's field, the voice memo draft as one whole-line button (mic, "Voice memo draft", its length in --block, "Continue" with the dotted mark) that opens the recorder on the draft.

form.description: status: an unsent entry or memo's line (a div, role status; no attribute). draft: the voice memo draft line, a button element (data-form="draft").

sub.description: The status form only. retrying: retrying on its own, in --rule-2, with Try again (no attribute). stopped: retries have given up (offline for a while), the same line in --rule, with Try again. sending: after Try again, no button, the arrow lifts and settles (--g-lift on --gc, looping; reduced motion: still).

text.description: status: "Not uploaded yet. Trying again.", "Not uploaded. We can't reach the server; it tries again when you're back online.", "Uploading…". draft: "Voice memo draft".

action.description: status: Try again's label ("Try again"); without it, or while sending, no button. draft: the word at the line's end, "Continue".

length.description: draft: the memo's length, "0:47", in --block with tabular figures.

label.description: draft: the button's accessible name, "Continue your voice memo draft, 0:47".

places.action: status: Try again, overhanging the line above and below so it keeps its 44px target in a line of text height; never wraps its label

states.hover: yes: draft: on a fine pointer Continue turns --block and its underline solid; status: Try again's own
states.focus-visible: yes: draft: the product focus ring (base) round the line; status: Try again's own
states.active: n/a: the draft line and Try again press as buttons (base and the button module)
states.disabled: n/a: neither can be refused; sending has no button instead
states.selected: n/a: nothing in it is selected
states.loading: yes: sending: "Uploading…", no button, the arrow lifts and settles
states.error: yes: stopped: the line in --rule, the words say the server can't be reached
states.empty: n/a: not drawn when nothing is pending

events.retry: Try again pressed (status): the row sends, the line shows sending, then goes when it is uploaded
events.continue: The draft line pressed: the recorder opens on the draft, paused

a11y.role: status form: role=status (its words are announced when they change); draft form: button
a11y.keyboard: status: Tab to Try again; draft: Tab to the line, Space or Enter
a11y.labels: draft: label names the button ("Continue your voice memo draft, 0:47"); the 14px glyphs are aria-hidden

changelog.change: v4 C5 (explore drafts a-quiet-line): the unsent line (retrying, stopped, sending) and the memo draft line.
Hooks words and length for the prototype runtime (C5 round 2). Fixed: the reduced-motion guard now outweighs the sending rule (it lost on specificity, so the lift ran under reduced motion).

hooks.retry: status: Try again (data-hook="retry"); the runtime sends the row again on a press.
hooks.words: The line's words (data-hook="words"); the runtime writes "Uploading…" when Try again is pressed.
hooks.length: draft: the memo's length (data-hook="length"); the runtime writes it.
